Find least additive-code redundancy at lengths of order r·2^k with distance above r, and compare it with kr.

For the three n=18 systems, measure degree-five annihilator local ranks and zero counts, testing tightness beyond sums of evaluations.
Read near-maximal resolution-width base formulas and test modular, shared-pin and occurrence ceilings on their encodings; source pending.
Construct or exclude near-half static barriers using saturated covers and odd-weight functions; verify the reviewer's small example and PC degree.

Extend queue history with titles and follow-ups of developing entries and entries citing the item, its children or their registered claims.
Require next steps for items with at most six prior entries to link each and quote its follow-up; test the recorded missed-history case.
Test restriction injectivity for near-half F2 bounds on symmetric non-affine wide rows and small-width encodings preserving free dimension.
